verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a user-defined rule that automatically triggers an action is a one-line llms.txt index entry: coverage reports can block pull-request merges based on configurable thresholds. That is a narrow, event-driven gate, not a general rules-to-actions automation engine. missing for 10: a general event-triggered automation or rules engine (e.g., alert-driven actions or workflows), documentation of configurable triggers and action types, in-depth first-party docs beyond an index line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Upload coverage reports to Datadog, visualize coverage data for pull requests, and block merges based on configurable thresholds.
